hero.title: Language Courses in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: **Language courses in Mauritius** are a good option for students, working professionals and international learners, who want to improve their communication skills for education, employment, travel or everyday life. Universities, cultural institutions and training providers are providing learners with the chance to learn English, French, Chinese and other languages. **Language courses in Mauritius** provide opportunities to learners with varying levels of proficiency and learning goals. These options also make **language learning in Mauritius** accessible to people with different academic and professional interests.

highlights.title: Bilingual & English Degrees
highlights.desc: Study in English with recognized qualifications from national institutions and global UK/Australian branch campuses.

highlights.desc: High quality tertiary education with tuition fees and living costs substantially lower than Western Europe.

highlights.title: Safe & Multicultural Island
highlights.desc: Consistently ranked as the safest and most politically stable nation in Africa with close cultural ties to India.

highlights.title: Simplified Visa Process
highlights.desc: Streamlined student visa procedures arranged directly through recognized higher education institutions.

overview: French language training and certification opportunities have been established by Mauritius through the Institut français de Maurice. The Open University of Mauritius provides foundation courses in English and French. The Mahatma Gandhi Institute also teaches languages, including an introduction to Modern Chinese. Students exploring **language courses in Mauritius for international students** can compare these options according to their learning requirements.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Language Courses in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Language Courses in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Language Courses in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
